text:
I originally came to Andreas because of an eight-week-old shoulder separation (AC) and made only very positive experiences so far. The practice is clean, tidy and easy to find. Andreas makes a great first impression, explains everything clearly, and is a true professional. He's from South Tyrol, friendly, open, and professional. You quickly feel that he is well educated and has massive experience with a wide range of conditions.

I now decided to work with him long-term because he achieves significant results with relatively little input. Of course, the prices are higher compared to Thailand, but honestly: it's a gift for what you get and he helps with reimbursement.
Thank you Andreas, for your passion and your honest wish to help! :)

Very grateful for Andreas' help! He is a very kind and knowledgeable physiotherapist who has helped me so much with my knee injury. He is very thorough with his assessments, treatment and teaching me exercises to strengthen my knee.

I've seen so much progress in just a few sessions and look forward to being able to enjoy sports more confidently, without the fear of my knee buckling.

Highly recommend Rehab-Point! ⭐

I visited Andreas Gschliesser at Rehab-point in HuaHin, for four sessions of physiotherapy. whilst I was on holiday visiting my Father.
I have recently had surgery on my shoulder, and wanted to keep attending Physiotherapy whilst away from home, so as not to lose momentum in rehabilitation.
My sessions with Andreas were extremely beneficial and I made progress in my range of movement even in the short time we worked together.
Andreas is extremely knowledgeable, and I learnt so much from him about my condition, and how the body responds and recovers from trauma and surgery.
Andreas was extremely generous with his time and he even took time to discuss some concerns I have about my son, in relation to concerns about movement. Andreas took the time to signpost me to further information and services that he felt may be of use to myself and my son.
I was so glad that I visited Andreas at rehab point, the clinic was easy to find with ample parking and was a lovely spacious light and airconditioned space to work in.
I am now implementing the exercises and movements that Andrea recommended, I feel I have a much better understanding of the rehabilitation process and recovery for my individual circumstances. I now have a clear pathway thanks to the time Andrea took to explain and work with me to show me a suitable rehab programme and to signpost me to relevant information and other therapists that may be able to help me in my home country. Thankyou so much to Rehab-point and to the wonderful Andreas, I will be back to see you the next time I am in town to show you my progress!!

I had four treatment sessions with Andreas in Hua Hin for leg swelling/lymphedema, and I was very happy with the care I received. He was professional, honest, and took the time to clearly explain the treatment and expected outcomes without making unrealistic promises.

The clinic was clean, welcoming, and very easy to find, which made the whole experience comfortable and stress-free. I also appreciated how carefully my progress was monitored throughout the sessions.

I would definitely recommend Andreas to anyone seeking physiotherapy or lymphatic treatment in Hua Hin. Thank you again for your help and care.

I've been there twice during my holiday in Huahin. I wish I could continue to go there to fully recover my leg pain, as it has been years... Andreas is a very competent person. He was very patient; he explained me what I have and how I can solve it (which exercises, what is the goal, when to stop etc..). He is also very honest, a quality which is very precious & rare nowadays.
He will do his best to help the patient.
I highly recommend him.

After 20 years of living with pain that no one could properly diagnose, Andreas at Rehab Point figured out it was my ulnar nerve within the first session. I can't describe how good it feels to finally have someone who knows exactly what's going on and has a clear plan to fix it. The prognosis is very positive and I'm genuinely optimistic for the first time in years. If you've been struggling with something long-term and feel like you've hit a wall, go see Andreas. He knows his stuff..

Andreas is a highly competent and sensitive health professional. He asks the right questions before he starts the treatment and he adapts and calibrates it according to the patient’s needs and healing progress. We can highly recommend him. Meeting him earlier would have spared my wife a lot of suffering.

Andreas is very knowledgeable. Provided great treatment for the both times I have seen him so far. Very clean office and facilities.

Appreciate the advice for my shoulder rehab.

I really appreciated the time and care Andreas first took to diagnose my condition. This was different to other physio experiences in Hua Hin which had tended start treatment straight away. As a result I was able to understand and improve my situation for the long-term. Highly recommended.

Personalised detailed therapy was done by Andreas. In a short span of 8 sessions there was remarkable improvement in movement. Totally recommend for expat visitors to Hua hin specially with an English speaking therapist

We are so lucky to have Andreas in the area!
He is a very skilful and knowledgeable physiotherapist and very precise in his diagnosis. He is also great at explaining why and what needs to be done to get better long term. We send all our friends, both Thais and farangs, to him if they have pain or physical problems. Highly recommended!
Absolutely top physiotherapy. The therapist takes extra time to actually heal the patient. 6 out of 5 stars.

I’d been suffering for months with intense back pain and saw several chiropractors and physios who were no help at all. From my first appointment with Andreas at Rehab-Point, I got a much clearer idea of my problem and of the road to recovery. It took a while as changing the way I’d walked for many years wasn’t easy but Andreas explained things clearly  and was very generous with his time. My back is still old and crusty, but I can walk progressively longer distances without pain. Highly recommended.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Highly Recommended!

I had treatment at Rehab-Point Hua Hin and I am absolutely impressed by the professionalism, expertise, and kindness of the entire team. From the very first visit, I felt I was in the best possible hands.

The therapists are highly skilled, take plenty of time for a thorough assessment, and explain every step in a very clear way. You immediately notice that they work with the latest evidence-based methods – always tailored to the individual and with great empathy.

What impressed me most is the combination of deep knowledge, modern techniques, and genuine humanity. You don’t just get “treated” here – you are cared for in a truly holistic way. After each session, I could feel real progress and always left with a very positive feeling.

Everything is extremely well organized: easy appointment scheduling, a warm and friendly welcome, spotless and modern facilities – simply perfect!

I am deeply grateful for the outstanding support and can wholeheartedly recommend Rehab-Point Hua Hin to anyone who values professional, sustainable, and compassionate physiotherapy.

For many years, I had been suffering from shoulder pain and numbness in both hands. I tried physical therapy at various places, but nothing seemed to help. I also visited doctors who only prescribed medication, which provided no lasting …
Really skilled and friendly physio. I highly recommend!

I had a fantastic experience at Rehab-Point with Andreas. He’s the first physiotherapist I’ve met who was able to clearly identify the root cause of my mom’s mobility limitations. What really stood out was how he focused on simple, practical improvements we could start with, and then gradually build on over time. His approach is thoughtful, effective, and easy to follow.

Not only friendly but very competent physiotherapist. He explained every exercise in detail and motivated me to address my problem. Definite progress after only a few weeks following his recommendations. Highly recommended.

After my lumbar spine surgery and spinal stenosis, I found the physiotherapy practice Rehab-Point.

Meeting Andreas was a real blessing.

He is highly competent, empathetic, and has extensive experience in various areas of physiotherapy.

He listens to his patients' complaints and always finds the right treatment approach.

I couldn't have wished for a better physiotherapist for my treatment.

Thank you so much for everything.

I had severe problems with my neck and back. The pain just wouldn't go away. Luckily, I found Rehab-Point online and made an appointment. Andreas greeted me, and I explained my problems to him. I could only turn my head slightly to the left …

I came to Andreas with a herniated disc in my cervical spine. During our initial consultation, he took a lot of time to understand my symptoms in detail, identify possible causes, and develop a suitable treatment plan. It's immediately apparent that he is very experienced and competent.

My cervical spine problems improved after just a short time. We conducted targeted tests to better understand the problem. This alone – along with his advice – gave me back the confidence to actively move my cervical spine again. Combined with the treatments and individually tailored exercises to do at home, I soon saw a significant improvement.

He works in a very scientific and solution-oriented manner, clearly explaining what is possible, what is necessary, and where the limits lie. He avoids the shady "joint cracking" approach you hear from chiropractors or osteopaths around the corner. Thank you, Andreas!

I had numbness in both hands and trigger finger. After receiving treatment here four times, the numbness and trigger finger have gradually improved. Before coming here, I went to many other places, but my condition didn't improve. The physiotherapists here gave very good and detailed advice on self-care after treatment. Thank you for helping me return to living a happy life.

I had chronic neck, shoulder, and upper back pain. I tried many treatments including massage, acupuncture, cupping, and medication, but nothing completely cured it until I found this clinic. I've been receiving continuous treatment from the doctor here, and my symptoms have gradually improved. However, the doctor said that treatment takes time because it's a chronic condition. Now I'm much better. I highly recommend trying treatment here. The doctor is very kind and caring.
